# Colour Attribute

Reads the base colour of each splat or point so you can edit or select by colour.

`lfs.colour_attribute` · Input

## How to use

Connect Colour to Separate Colour to inspect individual channels.  
This reads base colour, not camera-dependent reflections.  

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Colour | `Colour` | lfs.colour | — | — | Resulting RGB colour. 0 is black and 1 is white per channel; some calculations can exceed this range. |
